0022600025.text: The Hawks (5-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) host the Wizards (4-4, second in the Southeast and eighth in the East, half a game back) in Atlanta's 10th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Atlanta has won two straight and is 4-2 on the road and 1-2 at home, while Washington has lost its last game. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe), Jalen Johnson (ankle, game-time decision) and Jock Landale (hip) are day-to-day; Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The Hawks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-105 win in Washington on November 4, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
